exam_scheme.note: Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT) is conducted biannually by the Indian Air Force for granting Short Service Commission (SSC) in Flying Branch and Ground Duty (Technical and Non-Technical) Branches. The online examination consists of 100 objective questions carrying 300 marks of 120 minutes duration covering General Awareness, Verbal Ability in English, Numerical Ability, and Reasoning and Military Aptitude Test. Marking scheme: 3 marks for each correct answer and 1 mark deducted for each incorrect answer. Candidates who clear the online AFCAT cut-off are called for the Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) testing (Stage I: OIR & PPDT; Stage II: Psychological Tests, Group Tests, Personal Interview, and CPSS for Flying Branch).
